subject: item search
description: Draft GT: Home Item Search card → Product Search (page 6) → valid runtime item code search → populated product result verified (TC-BF-HOME-010-01-P01).
business_contract: User is authenticated and Home is reachable before Item Search (test preconditions; login is a separate flow).
From Home, Item Search opens Product Search (flow business_flow steps 1–2; observed_scenarios Home → Item Search).
Product Search page is ready (Playwright productSearchPage.expectPageReady).
Item Code input P6_SKU accepts the runtime item code (flow expected_success.search; observed Enter 14-character item code).
Search is submitted via the Search action (flow business_flow steps 5–6; observed Item Code → Search).
A populated product result is displayed for the searched item (flow business_flow step 7; test-cases expected_result.product_result).
Product identity is verified against the runtime item code (Playwright searchAndVerifyProduct → PRODUCT_SEARCH_TRACE:result_verified).
Evidence capture product-search-result-visible is produced on successful P01 (BF-HOME-010-01.spec.ts attachEvidence).

parameterization.notes: GT does not store literal SKU values. LIVE run used runtime parameter (e.g. SKU 552811DUDABA00 in goal) resolved to suite env, not embedded here.

evidence_basis.reference_run_notes: Successful LIVE_DEMO: 1 selected test (P01), 4 evidence captures; validator NEEDS_REVIEW pre_gt_honest until this GT is SME-approved.
